visuals.heading: Build One Table

items.heading: Build One Table
items.text: Build one table. Put every college on your actual shortlist across the top. Put the same eight data columns down the side.

items.heading: Searching "Best Colleges in India"
items.text: Searching "best colleges in India" gets you a list. A list is not a comparison, it ranks colleges against each other on criteria the list-maker chose, using data that may or may not match your branch, your field, or your specific shortlist.

items.heading: This Is the Actual Framework
items.text: This is the actual framework: eight columns, filled in with real data for every college on your shortlist, compared side by side in one table rather than five separate impressions.

items.heading: Ask How Many Students From
items.text: Ask how many students from the last graduating batch actually completed an internship through a listed tie-up , not just how many tie-ups the college has signed.

items.heading: Ask What Share of Internships
items.text: Ask what share of internships converted into a full-time offer (a pre-placement offer, or PPO) in the last one to two years, this conversion rate is a much stronger signal than the raw number of MoUs on a slide.

items.heading: Check Whether the Tie
items.text: Check whether the tie-up is branch-specific or college-wide , a strong MoU with a core-engineering firm does little for a management or arts student at the same college.

items.heading: Use the Aicte Internship Portal
items.text: Use the AICTE Internship Portal or the company's own careers page to cross-check whether a named partner company is actively running a verified internship program with that college, rather than relying only on the college's own claim.

items.heading: Relying on One Overall Ranking
items.text: Relying on one overall ranking list without checking what actually built that rank.

items.heading: Asking "Which College Is Better"
items.text: Asking "which college is better" instead of "which college is better for my branch, my budget, and my situation.".
